g.text: Post-crossing hold: paired severity on triggered OOF paths

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Nine matched paths per client; dots can overlap. The diagonal means equal full-horizon MDD.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Added severity = final MDD minus MDD at crossing; bar labels show annual / pending in percentage points.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Lower / equal / higher compares pending with annual MDD. All nine crossings per client persist in both arms.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Triggered subgroup only; annual observations and frozen fold-specific targets. These are descriptive outcomes, not CIs.
